name: @stevekinney/openclaw-slack-workspace
description: OpenClaw plugin with Slack workspace tools the bundled Slack channel plugin lacks: scheduling, search, structured messages, canvases, bookmarks, channel management, Slack Lists, files, and Workflow Builder triggers.
author: Steve Kinney

scripts.plugin:build: npm run build && openclaw plugins build --entry ./dist/index.js
scripts.plugin:check: npm run build && openclaw plugins build --check --entry ./dist/index.js
scripts.plugin:validate: npm run build && openclaw plugins validate --entry ./dist/index.js
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm run plugin:check && openclaw plugins validate --entry ./dist/index.js && npm test
